object.description: With DOC open in a Document Editor and read-only mode off, break its object file with conflict markers. Read the document again and paint the grid. Then select DOC-1, press F5, and switch read-only mode on and off. Expected: the grid keeps showing the copy read before (DOC-1's status Draft, DOC-1 in the Inspector); no grid cell offers an editor; after read-only mode is switched off the outline actions stay disabled.
